experiment_data.hypothesis: CKA functional overlap F(h) 预测结构化剪枝后 RLVR recoverability：高 overlap heads 被剪后 RLVR 更容易恢复其功能（通过调整相似 retained heads）。MVP 验证 Spearman ρ(F(h), recoverability) ≥ 0.4。

spec.command: bash src/run_mvp.sh (7-step pipeline: baseline eval → CKA+importance parallel → pruning parallel → post-prune eval → GRPO RLVR parallel → post-recovery eval → correlation analysis)
spec.failure_reason: Standard pruning violated GQA constraint (Q heads not divisible by KV heads after pruning) → forward pass crash. RASP pruning pruned 0 attention heads (all sparsity came from MLP). Root cause: per-Q-head pruning granularity instead of per-GQA-group.
